svg.text: Secure-by-Design Architecture — Edge-to-Data 7-Layer Defense, Identity & DDD Domain Invariants
Trust Boundaries · AuthN/AuthZ Separation (BFF + OIDC + Cedar/Zanzibar) · SPIFFE/SPIRE mTLS · Tenant Domain Primitives · CI/CD Gates
1. Edge & API Gateway (North-South)
L7 Edge: Global Cap & Cloud WAF
TLS 1.3 + HSTS (fail closed)
• L1a: Global DDoS shed (503)
• L4: WAF rules & body size cap
• Blocks traversal & bad methods
Untrusted internet -> DMZ seam
API Gateway & BFF AuthN Seam
• L2: Exact CORS origin allowlist
No reflected Origin; Vary: Origin
• L1b: Identity & tenant quotas
429 + Retry-After (not IP-only)
• BFF runs OAuth 2.1 PKCE + OIDC
HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite + RTR
No refresh tokens in localStorage
Browser Defense (CSRF & XSS)
• L6: Synchronizer token +
SameSite + Sec-Fetch-Site check
• L7: Strict CSP nonce +
Trusted Types + HTML encoding
2. Service Mesh, AuthZ & DDD Domain Boundary
L5: Zero-Trust East-West (SPIFFE/SPIRE + Signed Events)
spiffe://prod.example.com/ns/payments/sa/checkout
• Auto-rotated mTLS SVIDs; private RFC 1918 IP is untrusted
• Async streams: publisher signs envelope (Ed25519/ECDSA);
consumers verify signature before mutating domain state
Replaces flat VPNs with per-workload crypto identity
Resource-Level Authorization Composition (Default-Deny)
PolicyEngine: explicit FORBID overrides PERMIT; default DENY
• Composes RBAC + ABAC (tenant, MFA age) + ACL + ReBAC
• Enforced at owning service/schema — never only gateway
• Never cache AuthZ at CDN/edge; bind revocation TTLs
• Coarse scopes at gateway; object checks inside domain
DDD Domain Primitives & Invariants (TenantDomainGuard)
TenantScopedResourceId · BoundedMoneyAmount · VerifiedEmail
• Tenant ID bound from verified principal into storage key
• Eliminates BOLA/IDOR, bad amounts & mass assignment
• Legal FSM: PENDING -> ACTIVE <-> FROZEN, -> CLOSED
Invalid states cannot be built or reach persistence
3. Data Tier, Org Crypto & Structured Audit
Layer 3: Data-Tier Isolation & Injection Elimination
Parameterized SQL + SanitizedQueryFilter (no $ne / $where)
• PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) keyed on app.tenant_id
• Least-privilege roles: SELECT vs write; zero DDL in apps
• Mandatory TLS (sslmode=verify-full); no plaintext fallback
• Dynamic Vault/KMS creds + bounded connection pools
Org Crypto Policy & Compliance-by-Architecture
AES-256-GCM (unique nonce) · Argon2id · KMS DEK rotation
• Delivered via one internal crypto SDK (no ad-hoc repos)
• Regional residency cells + minimization + purpose checks
• GDPR erasure in WORM backups via crypto-shredding
• Hybrid PQC (X25519MLKEM768) for long-lived confidentiality
Framework-Level Redacting Audit Logger (WORM Sink)
FieldRedactingAuditLogger -> recursive key + regex masking
• Strips Auth, X-Api-Key, password, SSN, JWT, Luhn PAN
• Enforced in dev, staging & prod before JSON serialization
• Tamper-evident hash-chained audit for GDPR/HIPAA/PCI
4. Shift-Left Governance: Pre-Code Threat Modeling, Fail-Closed CI/CD Gates & Identity Taxonomy
Shift-Left Economics & Pre-Code STRIDE
Cost: 1x HLD -> 10x Dev -> 100x Prod -> 1000x Breach
• Embed Shostack's 4 questions into HLD/ADRs pre-code
• Map trust boundaries (DMZ, mesh, DB) & run STRIDE
• Record explicit mitigate/transfer/accept/eliminate
• Verify OWASP Top 10:2025 (A03, A10) & ASVS 5.0
• Operability: secure monolith beats unguarded mesh
a team cannot patch, rotate certs on, or observe
Fail-Closed CI/CD Gates (CiSecurityGateEvaluator)
dev (fast) -> staging (SLSA L2) -> prod (SLSA L3)
• Secret scans (full history + push block): unwaivable
• SAST + SCA triaged by CVSS v4 + KEV + EPSS + SSVC
• Lockfile check + signed CycloneDX SBOM + SLSA L3
• IaC policy-as-code & prod config assertions
• Fail-closed: secrets all envs; all scanners stg/prod
• Time-bounded waivers for non-KEV CVEs only
Untangling AuthN, AuthZ, SSO & Token Formats
AuthN ("Who?") != AuthZ ("What?") != SSO (UX pattern)
• OAuth 2.1 = delegated AuthZ (token != identity)
• OIDC = federated ID Token | SAML 2.0 = XML SSO
• JWT/PASETO = signed (not encrypted!); Bearer = wire
• Opaque Redis session vs JWT + BFF + RTR / DPoP
• Basic & RFC 7616 SHA-256 Digest unfit for web APIs
• API keys lack expiry/claims; hash at rest + rotate
